(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of straight-chain alkyl, branched-chain alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1 -C12-alkyl, C6 -aryl, or arylalkyl, wherein the alkyl is not ethyl.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals excluding potassium.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (Il b) in which Z is sodium.
